title: The Footwashers
text: At a crossroads shrine, old women sit with basins and rags, washing pilgrims' feet. Their hands are gentle and their eyes are sharp. They ask, as they wash, for news of the road, and they listen very carefully to every answer.

outcomes.text: Fresh feet and a lighter heart, and they hum while they work.

options.label: The best talker tells them the news of the road.

outcomes.text: They give news back, in low voices: what waits on the road ahead.
They bless you anyway, and it is a real blessing: the Leader's feet do not ache, and their scrapes close as they walk.
